_about: Official Microsoft Learn certification courses, built into learn.json by learn.py. Each course follows its Learn course (course: the course number) path by path and module by module; every unit that has a video becomes a step. exam: Microsoft Learn's own exam-prep playlist on YouTube (fetched by fetch.py) and cram: a study-cram video, both added as a last 'Exam prep' section. hubs: the focus sections the course shows up in.

courses.blurb: Cloud concepts and the core of Azure: compute, networking, storage, identity, governance and cost.
AI on Azure from the ground up: generative AI and agents in Microsoft Foundry, text, speech, vision and information extraction.
Core data concepts, relational and non-relational data on Azure, and analytics.
Run Azure day to day: identities and governance, storage, virtual networks, compute, and monitoring and backup.

courses.cert: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
courses.blurb: Build generative AI apps and agents with Microsoft Foundry: tools and MCP, Foundry IQ knowledge, Agent Framework, multi-agent orchestration and A2A, speech and vision.
The cloud side of AI apps: containers, Azure Container Apps and AKS, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL and Redis for AI, backend integration, and observability.
MLOps and GenAIOps on Azure: put machine learning models and generative AI apps into production, then evaluate, monitor and improve them.
Azure networking in depth: virtual networks, hybrid connections, load balancing, private access and network security.
Azure SQL: plan, secure, monitor, tune, automate and keep databases highly available.

courses.cert: Azure Cosmos DB AI Developer Associate
courses.blurb: AI applications on Azure Cosmos DB: design and develop with the NoSQL API, then secure, optimize and deploy, and add vector search and AI capabilities.
AI-enabled database solutions: design and develop databases, secure, optimize and deploy them, and build AI capabilities like vector search into them.
Design on Azure: identity, governance and monitoring, data storage, business continuity and infrastructure.
Production-grade multi-agent AI on Azure: architecture, building with Microsoft Foundry, deployment and governance, then monitoring and evaluation.
